warrant: base_2015_plikHM_TT_lowTEB_lensing.ini is an official upstream example deck (the Planck 2015 plikHM_TT_lowTEB_lensing baseline deck (one massive neutrino, halofit on)); the module's own excluded note records that the four upstream .ini decks are not vendored under code/class/ at this pin, so this check ships a byte-identical copy under ic/, the same pattern explanatory-end-to-end and thermodynamics already use for their own deck inputs. Every physical output file the deck writes is graded: the unlensed and lensed CMB spectra (all seven physical columns: TT, EE, TE, BB, phiphi, Tphi, Ephi) at an exact integer multipole key, and the matter power spectrum (and, where halofit runs, the baryon+CDM-only and non-linear variants) at a wavenumber key, all at atol=0, rtol=1e-6, tracking the driver's own high-precision print format. A wrong transfer projection, harmonic normalization, lensing convolution or non-linear correction anywhere in the pipeline will move at least one graded column beyond its bound on this independent, differently-parameterized cosmology from the C-driver test decks. The live omega_cdm variant (1e-9 relative, an active input this deck controls) moves every graded output file, unlike the identical variants the other checks in this leaf use because their upstream test drivers fix every input internally. The same-input -O2 build supplies the numerical-floor evidence.
